entry.title: NodalRed2x 0.1.0
entry.summary: First release of **NodalRed2x for MPC**: gearmulator's Clavia Nord Lead 2x emulation as a plugin instrument for MPC Gen2 standalones (MPC Live III and other aarch64 MPCs) on MPC OS 3.10 or later. - The original firmware on emulated hardware (68331 + two DSP56362). - A STARTERS bank, plus your own `.syx` / `.mid` sound sets (99 sounds per bank) with optional names (`tools/names_from_pdf.py` for Clavia's factory list). - Favourites in MPC's PRESET menu, MPC tempo sync for LFO 2 and the arpeggiator
